subject.title: fix(providers): keep local model discovery, retries, and cloud timeouts correct

question: Should unresolved managed SecretRefs immediately invalidate the affected Ollama dynamic catalog, accepting temporary model-discovery loss during a transient secret-provider failure in exchange for preventing cached private catalog reuse?
rationale: This is a deliberate security-versus-availability policy choice for existing configured providers; code review alone cannot determine the acceptable operational default.

options.title: Keep fail-closed invalidation
options.body: Clear the affected credential-scoped catalog when SecretRef resolution fails so prior private discovery data cannot survive a credential failure.

options.title: Retain prior catalog briefly
options.body: Define and document a bounded stale-cache policy for transient secret-provider outages, with explicit ownership and expiry semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed invalidation
recommendation.body: Clear the affected credential-scoped catalog when SecretRef resolution fails so prior private discovery data cannot survive a credential failure.
